description: A Jitendex definition-tag field is ASCII-space-joined, but an individual tag NAME carries NBSP internally: `old kanji form` is ONE tag. Seven of the eight canonical names in Jitendex's tag_bank_1.json are shaped that way (`priority form`, `irregular form`, `rarely used form`, ...). Splitting the field with generic whitespace classifies NBSP as whitespace (Unicode White_Space) and shreds the name into three chips `old` / `kanji` / `form`, so the name can never be matched against the tag table that parse_tag_bank loads intact. This pins the ASCII-space-only split. The payload is a plain-text (non-structured) glossary on purpose: a structured payload carries its own POS chips and never renders the entry-level tag field, so only this shape exercises the split. mobile_mirror is null -- PC-hosted formatting defect, not a mobile parity surface.

case.rules: old kanji form priority form | v5 | common
